description: The Repo Watch Agent monitors GitHub repositories for activity, generating detailed reports on commits, pull requests, and risky changes, and can send these reports to Slack.
name: repo-watch-agent

skills.description: List commits since a specified time for one or more GitHub repositories, providing details like hash, message, author, and date.
skills.name: List Commits

skills.description: Get the aggregated diff of files changed across all commits since a specified time for one or more repositories.
skills.name: Compare Diff

skills.description: Search for pull requests with activity (opened, merged, or closed) since a specified time across one or more repositories.
skills.name: Search Pull Requests

skills.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific commit in a GitHub repository, including its message, author, date, and changed files.
skills.name: Get Commit

skills.description: Read the full contents of a specific file in a GitHub repository at a given commit reference, allowing for detailed analysis of changes.
skills.name: Read File

skills.description: Find files in a GitHub repository that reference a specific symbol, helping to identify impacted files due to changes.
skills.name: Find References
